records.shell_command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -B - <<'PY'
import base64, copy, hashlib, importlib.util, json
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('/Users/kelvin/Documents/ChatGPT/ReplayEvidence/biglotto-final-receipt-r2-20261015-output')
result_path = root / 'result.json'
receipt_path = root / 'receipt.jsonl'
result_bytes = result_path.read_bytes()
receipt_bytes = receipt_path.read_bytes()
result_sha = hashlib.sha256(result_bytes).hexdigest()
receipt_sha = hashlib.sha256(receipt_bytes).hexdigest()
expected_result_sha = 'b272b4bf2a44363ac0df6b62d92df2245a4a443a1718da926e2232b05cf22046'
expected_receipt_sha = 'f8615e2ff27886193f6e496f5f96fc3cfb0850fe7c07e393f5560799364d870c'
assert result_sha == expected_result_sha, 'existing result.json differs from its cited SHA256'
assert receipt_sha == expected_receipt_sha, 'existing receipt.jsonl differs from its cited SHA256'

runner_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('run_single_execution_receipt', 'tools/run_single_execution_receipt.py')
runner = importlib.util.module_from_spec(runner_spec)
runner_spec.loader.exec_module(runner)
recorder_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('capture_single_execution_receipt', 'tools/capture_single_execution_receipt.py')
recorder = importlib.util.module_from_spec(recorder_spec)
recorder_spec.loader.exec_module(recorder)
old = json.loads(result_bytes)
assert old['schema'] == 'biglotto-single-execution-run-v1'
old_embedded = base64.b64decode(old['receipt']['evidence']['raw_base64'], validate=True)
assert old_embedded == receipt_bytes
accepted = recorder.accept_receipt(receipt_bytes, receipt_sha, 0)
assert accepted['accepted'] is True, accepted

candidate = copy.deepcopy(old)
candidate['schema'] = 'biglotto-single-execution-run-v2'
candidate['receipt']['evidence'] = runner.evidence_reference(receipt_bytes, receipt_path.name)
new_result_bytes = (json.dumps(candidate, ensure_ascii=True, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False, indent=2) + '\\n').encode('utf-8')
old_total = len(result_bytes) + len(receipt_bytes)
new_total = len(new_result_bytes) + len(receipt_bytes)
assert 'raw_base64' not in candidate['receipt']['evidence']
assert candidate['receipt']['evidence']['sha256'] == receipt_sha
assert candidate['receipt']['evidence']['reference'] == 'receipt.jsonl'
print(json.dumps({
    'existing_v1_result_sha256': result_sha,
    'existing_receipt_sha256': receipt_sha,
    'existing_receipt_accepted': accepted['accepted'],
    'old_result_bytes': len(result_bytes),
    'receipt_source_bytes': len(receipt_bytes),
    'new_v2_result_bytes_same_run': len(new_result_bytes),
    'bundle_bytes_before': old_total,
    'bundle_bytes_after': new_total,
    'bytes_saved': old_total - new_total,
    'percent_saved': round((old_total - new_total) * 100 / old_total, 2),
    'existing_artifacts_modified': False,
}, sort_keys=True))

    def replace_authorization(_seconds):
        changed = json.loads(marker.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))
        changed[\"state\"] = \"REVOKED_DURING_CLOSE\"
        replacement = marker.with_suffix(\".replacement\")
        replacement.write_text(json.dumps(changed, sort_keys=True, separators=(\",\", \":\")) + \"\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")

        and not list(marker.parent.glob(f\".{marker.name}.closing.*\"))

    if not preserved:
        raise SystemExit(json.dumps({
            \"status\": \"FAIL\",
            \"blocked\": blocked,
            \"worktree_exists\": worktree.is_dir(),
            \"worktree_registered\": worktree.resolve() in fac._parse_worktree_list(repo),
            \"marker_state\": current.get(\"state\"),
            \"claim_dirs\": [str(path) for path in marker.parent.glob(f\".{marker.name}.closing.*\")],
        }, indent=2))
    print(json.dumps({
        \"status\": \"PASS\",
        \"authorization_change_between_validation_and_remove\": \"BLOCKED\",
        \"worktree_preserved\": True,
        \"changed_marker_preserved\": True,
        \"claim_artifacts_cleaned_or_restored\": True,

    }, indent=2))

import ast
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(\"/Users/kelvin/VibeCoding-WorkSpace/MathStatisticalAnalysis\")
bundle = root / \"tools/fable_review_bundle_r1\"
manifest_path = bundle / \"candidate_manifest.json\"
manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))
checks = {}
for key in (\"installed_skill\", \"original_skill_backup\", \"installed_helper\", \"receipt_producer\"):
    row = manifest[\"sources\"][key]
    candidate_path = (root / row[\"path\"]) if not Path(row[\"path\"]).is_absolute() else Path(row[\"path\"])
    snapshot = root / \"tools/fable_review_bundle_r1\" / row[\"snapshot\"] if \"snapshot\" in row else candidate_path
    checks[f\"{key}_source_sha\"] = hashlib.sha256(candidate_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == row[\"sha256\"]
    checks[f\"{key}_snapshot_sha\"] = hashlib.sha256(snapshot.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == row[\"sha256\"]
for item in manifest[\"problem_evidence\"]:
    for kind in (\"execution_record\", \"capture\"):
        ref = item[kind]
        checks[f\"{item['execution_id']}_{kind}\"] = hashlib.sha256((root / ref[\"path\"]).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == ref[\"sha256\"]
orphan = manifest[\"historical_inventory\"][\"orphan_capture\"]
checks[\"orphan_capture_sha\"] = hashlib.sha256((root / orphan[\"path\"]).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == orphan[\"sha256\"]
for path in (
    bundle / \"fable-method/scripts/fable_artifact_controls.py\",
    root / \"tools/run_single_execution_receipt.py\",
    bundle / \"authorization_race_regression.py\",
):
    ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))
checks[\"python_sources_parse\"] = True
checks[\"goal_mapping\"] = (
    manifest[\"goal_mapping\"][\"original_task_id\"] == \"FABLE_ARTIFACT_BUDGET_AND_LIFECYCLE_R1\"
    and manifest[\"goal_mapping\"][\"current_goal_id\"] == \"FABLE_EVIDENCE_FEEDBACK_AND_STORAGE_OPTIMIZATION_R1\"
)
print(json.dumps({\"status\": \"PASS\" if all(checks.values()) else \"FAIL\", \"checks\": checks}, indent=2))
if not all(checks.values()):
    raise SystemExit(1)
